description: HubSpot CRM connector (read-only). Surfaces the authenticated portal's deals as hubspot:deal items in the local index via GET /crm/v3/objects/deals — the deal name, the amount, the deal stage, the pipeline, the close date, the create date, and the last-modified timestamp. Bearer OAuth auth (Authorization: Bearer <token>; short-lived access token refreshed by the Gateway via the 3-legged OAuth authorization-code flow; never logged); fixed SaaS host api.hubapi.com. The list endpoint paginates by the paging.next.after cursor until absent; the gateway-side syncable walks a single forward pass per cycle, page-capped. Read-only — hitlRequired is intentionally empty. Sparse structured pipeline/spend metadata; deal URLs require a portal id the API does not return, so url/canonical_url are null.
author: Nimbus
